# Independent ordered-selector oracle

`alpha.aseprite`, `beta.aseprite`, and `generate.lua` are original CC0 numerical fixtures. `oracle.json` contains output generated by the self-built official Aseprite 1.3.18.5 executable, with source hashes and origin details. No Aseprite implementation code or third-party sample art is included.

`generate-oracle.mjs` reproduces the native invocations when `ASEPRITE` points to that executable. It regenerates the original sources, stores native PNG/JSON outputs under `native/`, and records every output RGBA byte, dimension, duration, and source order. That output folder is diagnostic and need not be checked in. The PNG reader only decodes the native output; it does not decide input option semantics or expected pixels.

Tests verify 22 cases for persistent includes/exclusions, replacement tags/ranges, layer splitting/visibility before, between and after inputs, and combined selectors. Native filenames are recorded without claiming PixelWall uses identical inferred names. The new `--ordered-inputs` mode is an explicit compatibility choice so existing PixelWall commands with trailing global flags retain their behavior.

Official reference: https://www.aseprite.org/docs/cli/
Official source release: https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/releases/download/v1.3.18.5/Aseprite-v1.3.18.5-Source.zip
